## Interpretation

Zarman Exchange Pty Ltd is the company named on the About page. Persian is served at /fa and English at /en. AUD means Australian dollar; the website uses IRT for Iranian toman amounts. Quotes, fees, loyalty settings, availability and settlement times depend on the transaction. Check the visible quote and its update time; this file is not a current rate feed.
